name: Neon Nebula: Overdrive Edition
description:
Blast your way through neon galaxies in Neon Nebula: Overdrive Edition! Take control of a powerful starfighter in this high-octane, retro-inspired arcade space shooter. 

Featuring fluid physics, progressive enemy waves, and dynamic weapon upgrade systems, you'll need sharp reflexes to survive the particle-rich cosmic chaos. Dodge hostile firing lines, collect power-ups, and obliterate the alien variants to secure your spot as the ultimate space pilot. 

Optimized natively for Windows with smooth keyboard and mouse controls!
